jobs.name: bodies
jobs.instructions: Front-facing headless BUST garment only, cropped horizontally at lower chest. Gently sloping shoulders from neck to upper arms, generous hanging cloth, NOT a dome or pill silhouette. A SMALL centered open neck socket at top: no skin, head, neck, hands, mannequin or hair. Every bust same frontal orientation and chest crop. Opaque near-white main cloth with grey flat fold shapes so the game can tint it. Warm-black expressive carved outline and meaningful curved fold strokes, not shiny shading. Collar must actually surround the neck socket. Visible placket or overlap continues naturally down the chest. Never draw a head or skin inside the garment. First five are plain loose woven-cloth robe bases: standard, broad shoulders, slender, sloping shoulders, squarer shoulders; simple neck socket, subtle shoulder seams, hanging sleeve folds. Remaining six are restrained medieval Vietnamese armour interpretations: cloth-bound small overlapping plates, vertical laced lamellae, curved fish-scale plates, subdued studded fabric, stitched dark leather panels, then overlapping scalloped plates. Design armour construction with repeated plates/laces and binding; do NOT merely draw wavy lines on a shirt. No horns, fantasy shoulder beasts, European armour, modern tactical armour or Chinese film costume. All tintable armour surfaces near-white/light grey too; strong black details survive dark game tint. Complete neck-facing included.
